source.note: Illustrations are synthetic; not reported measurements.

charts.name: Line chart
charts.caution: Use real observation dates; label missing periods.

charts.name: Area chart
charts.caution: Avoid if overlapping series obscure each other.

charts.name: Stacked area
charts.bestFor: How component totals change over time
charts.caution: Absolute amounts and shares answer different questions.

charts.name: Step chart
charts.bestFor: Values that change at discrete events
charts.caution: Do not interpolate gradual change between steps.

charts.name: Candlestick
charts.bestFor: Open, high, low, close per interval
charts.caution: Price candles do not show transaction volume.

charts.name: Sparkline
charts.caution: Pair with a clear metric, unit, and time window.

charts.name: Slopegraph
charts.bestFor: Before/after change across a few categories
charts.editorialExample: Site power draw before and after upgrades
charts.caution: Two endpoints cannot prove what happened between.

charts.name: Bump chart
charts.bestFor: Rank positions as they change over time
charts.editorialExample: Top GPU vendors by yearly shipment rank
charts.caution: Show rank, not absolute share, on the vertical axis.

charts.name: Horizontal / vertical bar
charts.editorialExample: Largest data center projects by MW
charts.caution: Start the value axis at zero for ordinary bars.

charts.name: Grouped bars
charts.editorialExample: Proposed versus operating MW by state
charts.caution: Too many group members become unreadable.

charts.name: Stacked bars
charts.editorialExample: AI server bill of materials by supplier
charts.caution: Internal components are hard to compare across bars.

charts.name: 100% stacked bars
charts.caution: Does not reveal total underlying market size.

charts.name: Lollipop
charts.bestFor: Ranked values in a lightweight format
charts.caution: Keep baseline and sorting consistent.

charts.name: Dumbbell
charts.caution: Clearly identify what each endpoint represents.

charts.name: Bullet
charts.editorialExample: Data center utilization versus safe limit
charts.caution: Do not bury the target benchmark.

charts.name: Waterfall
charts.bestFor: How positive and negative changes build a total
charts.editorialExample: MW added or lost from facility capacity
charts.caution: Make start, contributions, and end reconcile.

charts.name: Pareto
charts.caution: Measure causes by the same denominator.

charts.name: Tornado
charts.bestFor: How alternative inputs affect an outcome
charts.editorialExample: Robot ROI sensitivity to labor and energy costs
charts.caution: State baseline and scenario assumptions.

charts.name: Histogram
charts.caution: Bin widths can change the perceived shape.

charts.name: Box-and-whisker
charts.caution: State quartile and whisker definitions.

charts.name: Violin
charts.caution: Needs sufficient observations and a defined scale.

charts.name: Dot / beeswarm
charts.caution: Avoid jitter that disguises the actual values.

charts.name: Density curve
charts.editorialExample: Server power-draw profiles across a fleet
charts.caution: Smoothing is not raw observations.

charts.name: Scatter plot
charts.caution: Correlation alone does not prove causation.

charts.name: Bubble chart
charts.bestFor: Two variables plus a size dimension
charts.editorialExample: Robot cost, throughput, and fleet size
charts.caution: Circle area—not radius—must represent size.

charts.name: Heatmap
charts.bestFor: Values across two categories or dimensions
charts.editorialExample: Server temperature by rack and time
charts.caution: Use a legend with meaningful units.

charts.name: Hexbin plot
charts.editorialExample: Millions of data center telemetry samples
charts.caution: Hexagon counts depend on spatial bin size.

charts.name: Pie / donut
charts.bestFor: A few shares of one complete total
charts.caution: Shares must sum to the whole; avoid many slices.

charts.name: Treemap
charts.caution: Area labels must match the same denominator.

charts.name: Waffle
charts.editorialExample: Share of a factory fleet with upgraded ASICs
charts.caution: Define rounding and total number of cells.

charts.name: Sunburst
charts.caution: Too many levels make labels unreadable.

charts.name: Sankey
charts.caution: Flow values must conserve quantity.

charts.name: Funnel
charts.caution: Only use when populations truly pass sequential stages.

charts.name: Gantt / timeline
charts.bestFor: Start, finish, and overlap for activities
charts.caution: Do not label planned dates as completed milestones.

charts.name: Calendar heatmap
charts.bestFor: Daily activity over weeks or months
charts.editorialExample: Data center incidents by calendar day
charts.caution: Normalize if days have unequal exposure.

charts.name: Control chart
charts.editorialExample: Coolant flow variation with control limits
charts.caution: Use statistical limits, not arbitrary decoration.

charts.name: Gauge
charts.bestFor: Current level against a bounded limit
charts.caution: A single number plus target may be clearer.

charts.name: Radar / spider
charts.caution: Normalize dimensions and avoid arbitrary scores.

charts.name: Choropleth map
charts.bestFor: A value assigned to each region
charts.caution: Use rates for fair comparisons between regions.

charts.name: Proportional-symbol map
charts.editorialExample: MW at individual data center project locations
charts.caution: Use area-scaled symbols and verified coordinates.
